penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Resolving 2GP packaging failures for Data Cloud DMOs requires hands-on Salesforce CLI work, package metadata debugging, and potentially filing Salesforce Known Issues — per-ISV, per-engagement manual technical work that cannot be automated by Claude alone.

rationale: The buyer exists and pays — Salesforce ISVs are businesses with budgets, and packaging blockers are expensive delays — but the solution requires deep Salesforce platform expertise (2GP package internals, Data Cloud DMO metadata structure, sf CLI tooling) that is entirely outside what Claude prompts and a landing page can deliver. Buildability_with_ai scores 2 because there is no way to build a useful product here without a Salesforce-certified developer writing and debugging actual package metadata. Operational_autonomy scores 3 because even if a consulting workaround were documented, every new ISV customer would need a hands-on engagement. After the human-fulfillment penalty the total drops to 3.6. Both critical build gates fail decisively.
solution_plan: This is not buildable by a solo non-technical operator using the Claude factory. The problem is a very specific Salesforce platform limitation (Data Cloud DMO objects cannot currently be included in 2GP unlocked packages) that may require either a Salesforce platform bug fix or an undocumented workaround involving managed package metadata and org-shape configuration. A viable product would be either a consulting engagement (per-customer manual work — not autonomous) or a documentation/template bundle (very low willingness to pay, easily copied). The narrow technical specificity and the requirement for a Salesforce developer to actually test and validate any solution puts this firmly out of scope for this factory. Recommend dropping; revisit only if the factory acquires a Salesforce-credentialed technical collaborator.
notes: Fails buildability_with_ai build gate (score 2, floor 6) and operational_autonomy build gate (score 3, floor 7). Extremely niche Salesforce ISV problem requiring platform-level developer expertise. Not viable for autonomous Claude factory delivery.
